column1: # Provenance of vendored files (ADR-0001). One row per file, tab-separated:
#   local path <TAB> upstream repo <TAB> upstream path <TAB> upstream blob sha we last reviewed
# The sha tracks UPSTREAM, not our copy: a vendored file is expected to differ locally
# has moved past the reviewed sha; `--update` pulls the new content and re-pins.
# `unreviewed` means upstream has never been diffed against our copy — always reported.
# `caveman` is not listed: it has no discoverable upstream in mattpocock/skills.
